_crossover_note: Edge Assembly Crossover (single-AB-cycle). Replaced OX as the baseline crossover: under an identical GA (perm init, binary tournament, swap/inversion mutation, 1-elitism, pop=100, 50k FEs) EAX beat OX on every instance - e.g. st70 mean tour 707.5 (+4.8%) vs 1802.7 (+167%), Wilcoxon p ≈ 2e-9.
_stopping_note: Halt at 5,000 generations × pop_size = 500,000 cumulative function evaluations. The runner currently supports FE-budget stopping only; max_generations is recorded for documentation.
_note: Instance files are bundled in data/tsplib/. scripts/fetch_tsplib.py can re-download them.
